messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Standby interviewer pool - activation request

Hi all,

Hiring update: we’ve just greenlit an accelerated interview cadence for the Backend Eng cohort and need to activate a "standby" interviewer pool for the next 10 business days (roughly Oct 21–Nov 3). Expected load: ~18 full-panel interviews and ~12 short-screen reserves, several with candidates in EMEA windows.

Ask: can you confirm coverage availability (primary or backup) for any 3-hour window this week? We’re trying to avoid repeated late-night panels but need flexible coverage. I uploaded a draft roster (interviewer-standby-roster.xlsx) with suggested shifts and incentives (override credit for last-minute coverage).

Key notes:
- Please reply with 1) your preferred shift(s), 2) whether you can take short-notice swaps (<=4h), and 3) if you’re ok being a shadow backup (no scoring) for capacity spikes.
- Confirm by EOD Wed, Oct 21 so we can lock the schedule and notify candidates.

Attachments: interviewer-standby-roster.xlsx

Thanks — Mina
